decision: blocking first step: reproduce the inline filter dropping a ReparsePoint placeholder at baseline before any edit
why: prove it works: no reproduction, no fix

decision: independent workstreams: (1) uploader-lib.ps1 + harness, (2) main-script call site, (3) loop-verify.sh + DEV-HANDOFF.md doc fix
why: sequence work into verifiable units: lib+harness is the only unit that needs iteration, the rest are one-line wirings gated by it

decision: shared mutable state touched: none in the lib (pure functions, no top-level side effects); main script keeps $entries/$seenRel accumulation unchanged
why: minimize reader load: filter policy moves out, dedupe/rel-path policy stays at the call site

decision: smallest safe decomposition: Get-UploadSkipReason (pure, per-file, string reason) under Get-UploadCandidates (walk + tally); main script iterates .Candidates only
why: model the domain: a skip is a named reason (link|temp|dotfile|extension), not a boolean, so uploader-2 diagnostics read counts off the same structure

decision: reproduced at baseline 470557d: inline filter returns 0 candidates for a ReparsePoint file with empty LinkType
why: confidence ladder 4: ran the filter expression, got 0

decision: Test-RealLink reads LinkType only; the ReparsePoint attribute is never consulted
why: fix root causes: the attribute is set on every Files On-Demand file, so it can never distinguish a link from a placeholder; LinkType can

decision: skip reason is a string (link|temp|dotfile|extension), not a boolean, and Get-UploadCandidates returns Candidates/Skipped/Errors/Walked
why: model the domain: uploader-2 diagnostics read the tally off the same structure instead of re-walking

decision: LinkType read via $file.PSObject.Properties[LinkType] instead of direct property access
why: boundary discipline: fakes and providers without the property must be judged not-a-link, never throw under Set-StrictMode
boundary discipline: a client folder named "Applications [2024]" is a literal path; -Path would treat the brackets as a wildcard and silently walk nothing

decision: Candidates returned via List.ToArray() instead of @($list)
why: prove it works: @() around a New-Object List[object] throws "Argument types do not match" on the harness host pwsh 7.6.5

decision: mutation check: restored the old attribute rule inside Test-RealLink and re-ran the full gate
why: confidence ladder 4: a harness that cannot fail proves nothing; gate exited 1 with AC1 failing
laziness protocol: the zip is a denylist, so uploader-lib.ps1 ships automatically and only the harness needed excluding

decision: AC6 proven with an AST scan for TernaryExpressionAst/Coalesce plus a parse of all three .ps1 files, not the ticket regex
